statement: xpadneo constructs Bluetooth rumble report ID 0x03 with main and trigger motor fields. Through ordinary Linux FF_RUMBLE, it computes both trigger amplitudes from the larger of the two main rumble magnitudes weighted by current trigger pressure, unless disabled by policy or quirks. Thus it can command trigger-motor fields, but does not provide four independent application-controlled evdev FF magnitudes.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.scope: rumble.c:18-41, 56-135, 150-219; trigger motor actuation on reference hardware not observed.
